mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.1 percentage point rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and earnings growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.1pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 2 years is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is <0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO < 100) elevates input costs and reduces corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high quarterly GDP level (GDPC1 > 16500 billion) signals robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through accelerated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when GDPC1 > 16500, or the Rank IC over 3 years is <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%) triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction is <0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) increases discount rates and reduces risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is <0.03.
